changelog:
Initial release of the Web Accessibility Auditor skill.

- Audits HTML/CSS for WCAG 2.1 compliance.
- Checks color contrast, ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, and screen reader support.
- Provides detailed, actionable suggestions with code examples.
- Follows industry best practices and explains trade-offs when multiple solutions exist.
summary: Audits HTML/CSS for WCAG 2.1 compliance. Color contrast, ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, screen reader support.
